[RCLI.1.1] **The command line is subcommand-based.** `dsc` dispatches on a
leading subcommand; the admissible set and the shape of each invocation are the
`subcommand` and `dsc_invocation` productions of `compiler/dsc_cli.ebnf`.

The surface admits `compile`, `compile-project`, `dump-schemas`, `dump-ast`
([RCLI.1.10]) and `check` ([RCLI.1.12]), and `--help` ([RCLI.1.13]). A further
subcommand attaches without restructuring the surface, so adding one is a grammar
change and a clause here, not a redesign.
